item.description: USFS personnel are currently working through planning processes for logging, mining, and energy projects, Nelson said.

item.title: One of Alaska’s flagship mines soon could draw energy from the sun - Chilkat Valley News
item.description: If built, a newly proposed 8.8-megawatt solar farm at Red Dog would have slightly more capacity than the state’s largest existing farm, in the Susitna Valley north of Anchorag

item.title: USFS to release details on formulating forest plan - Chilkat Valley News
item.description: The Monday of the release will mark the beginning of a 45-day public comment period, which will be open until May 7. During this time, members of the public can view and share their positions on the current state of the Tongass National Forest Plan.

item.description: Chilkat Valley News reporter Will Steinfeld sat down with KHNS news director Melinda Munson to talk about the upcoming Haines Borough Assembly meeting.

item.title: Rough draft of revised Tongass plan envisioning more resource development released for public comment - Chilkat Valley News
item.description: The Forest Service’s timeline, as of Monday, calls for a draft Environmental Impact Statement by August of this year, a final EIS by May of 2027, a decision by October of 2027 and implementation of the revised plan by November of 2027.

item.title: This Week in History: Average Haines age, extreme ski contest and border relocation - Chilkat Valley News

item.title: Haines starts strong at Gold Medal - Chilkat Valley News
